title: University of Melbourne Theme
subtitle: Sales, Freight, and Unit Distribution dashboard styled with the University of Melbourne brand theme in Power BI Desktop.

visuals.title: University of Melbourne Theme
notes: Executive report header displaying title 'University of Melbourne Theme' in elegant light typography.

visuals.title: Sales by Brand & Color
notes: Tabular inventory of SalesAmount by BrandName and Color with dark navy headers and total row ($40,640,973.42).

visuals.title: Freight by BrandName and Class
notes: Nested proportional rectangles displaying freight spend across brand names partitioned by product class (Regular, Deluxe, Economy).

visuals.title: Units by Year, Quarter, Month and Class
notes: Multi-series timeline tracking unit sales volume across product classes (Deluxe, Economy, Regular) from 2012 to 2015.

visuals.title: Units by SubCategory and SubCategory
notes: Ranked clustered columns displaying unit volumes across 8 key subcategories, colored using the University of Melbourne palette.

sections.title: Prepare & Theme
items: Open Microsoft Power BI Desktop optimized for Report Server (January 2026, build 2.150.5353.0).
Navigate to View > Themes > Browse for themes and import 'university-of-melbourne.theme.json'.
Verify canvas background color is set to #F5F8FC at 0% transparency (Format page > Canvas background).
Confirm report dimensions are set to 16:9 widescreen (1280 x 720 px).

sections.title: Visual Construction
items: Insert Text Box or Card visual at [320, 15, 640, 50] for report header 'University of Melbourne Theme'.
Insert Table visual at [15, 75, 375, 630] and add Product[BrandName], Product[Color], and Measures[SalesAmount] to Columns.
Configure Table visual headers with #003366 background and white text, and enable Total row ($40,640,973.42).
Insert Treemap visual at [405, 75, 435, 290] and add Product[BrandName] to Category, Product[Class] to Details, and Measures[Freight] to Values.
Insert Line chart visual at [855, 75, 410, 290], assigning Calendar[Date Hierarchy] to X-axis, Measures[Units] to Y-axis, and Product[Class] to Legend.
Insert Clustered column chart visual at [405, 380, 860, 325], assigning Product[SubCategory] to X-axis, Measures[Units] to Y-axis, and Product[SubCategory] to Legend.

sections.title: Formatting & Polish
items: Verify visual palette mappings against the theme's 12 dataColors.
Verify alignment and 15px/20px gutters across table, treemap, line chart, and column chart.
Format numeric display units on Cartesian axes to display in Thousands (K).
Test cross-filtering by clicking a brand in the Table or Treemap and observing responsive updates across charts.

acceptance: Theme JSON imports cleanly with #003366 primary, #214F80 secondary, and #F5F8FC canvas background.
Table visual displays all brand colors with grand total $40,640,973.42.
Treemap visual correctly groups freight by BrandName and subdivides into product classes.
Line chart displays 3 distinct trend lines (Deluxe, Economy, Regular) over 2012-2015 timeline.
Clustered column chart displays 8 descending category bars with individual theme colors.
All visuals maintain precise coordinates with zero page boundary clipping.
